record.question: False about tight heparinization:
options: Continue heparin till the end of dialysis
Initial bolus 750 U followed by infusion rate 600 U/hour
record.explanation: Answer C: Continue heparin till the end of dialysis. In tight heparinization, heparin is generally stopped before the end of dialysis to allow anticoagulant effect to decline before needle removal; continuing it to the end is the false statement. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK539848/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
